name: shortfilm-prompt
title_zh: 五段式电影级短片提示词生成器
tagline_zh: 给 Seedance、Sora、Kling 等视频模型写提示词，从丧尸追逃到亲情催泪，按五幕结构拆解。
tagline_en: Turn any idea into a 5-act cinematic prompt for Seedance, Sora, Kling & more—from zombie chases to tearjerker.
desc_en: Generate cinematic AI shortfilm prompts (works with Seedance 2.0, Xiaoyunque, Sora, Kling, Jimeng, Veo) using the 5-stage structure from Mx-Shell's Zombie Scavenger. Trigger when the user wants transformation sequences, multi-shot narrative shorts, weapon-charge/combat segments, emotional family/pet/farewell narratives (催泪/亲情/萌宠/离别), or any cinematic video prompt.
why_zh: 不是堆形容词，而是把镜头语言拆成可执行的五幕结构，让多镜头叙事、武器充能、情感爆发都有明确的节奏落点。
why_en: It's not adjective soup—it's a 5-act scaffold that gives multi-shot narratives, charge-ups, and emotional beats a precise rhythm.
limit_zh: 只生成提示词文本，不负责视频渲染或分镜图；依赖目标模型对五幕结构的理解力，Veo 和 Kling 表现优于部分国产模型。
limit_en: Outputs text prompts only—no rendering or storyboards. Relies on target model's grasp of 5-act structure; Veo/Kling outperform some domestic models.
